subject: Scientific instrument - Strait of Georgia
text:
Scientific instrument - Strait of Georgia
A bottom mounted data retrieving instrument has been established in the Strait of Georgia at 49 01.212N 123 11.688W.
The top of the instrument will be 1.0 meters above the seabed and a 60 meter groundline with a weighted line will extend along the seabed. 
will be in place for approximately 1 year.
